meta.description: What changed in Mewvo, newest first.

head.title: Changelog
head.lead: What changed in Mewvo, newest first. A change is listed when it is finished. The bot in your server gets it at its next update.

2026-11-01.customAutomodRules: Custom automod rules: add your own words and phrases to block, with /automod custom or on the dashboard. You can change the words of a rule later. Part of the Normal, Pro and Max plans.
2026-11-01.remind: /remind: set a reminder for yourself. Mewvo sends it to you in a DM, or in the channel if your DMs are closed.
2026-11-01.profile: /profile: your level, rank, next role reward, birthday and plan on one card.
2026-11-01.appealStatus: /appeal status: see your appeals and whether someone on staff is looking at them.
2026-11-01.recordLinkInDms: Punishment DMs can link to My record, where you see your full record on the website.
2026-11-01.gettingStartedList: Dashboard: the Overview page starts with a short getting-started list, and every settings page explains its options in plain words.
2026-11-01.activityPage: Dashboard: an Activity page with messages, joins and cases per day for the last 30 days.
2026-11-01.settingsBackup: Dashboard: a settings backup you can download and load back after a check.
2026-11-01.caseNotesAndTags: Dashboard: private staff notes and tags on cases, actions on many cases at once, and saved searches.
2026-11-01.shiftNote: Dashboard: a note for the next staff shift on the Overview page.
2026-11-01.weeklySummary: A weekly summary of the server in the mod log every Monday.
2026-11-01.proMaxBranding: Pro and Max: Mewvo can use its own nickname and avatar in your server, and staff can download cases as a spreadsheet.
2026-11-01.dashboardThemes: Dashboard themes: Light, Dark, Dim and High contrast.

2026-10-31.legalPages: Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions.
2026-10-31.dataDownload: My record: download all the data Mewvo has about you as a file.
2026-10-31.paidPlans: Paid plans now do something: supporter roles, /premium, gifts and redeem keys.

2026-10-29.rename: The bot is now called Mewvo (it was Meowist).
2026-10-29.serverRules: Server rules on the website. Punishment DMs name the rule that was broken and link to it.
2026-10-29.independentAppeals: Appeals are decided by someone other than the moderator who gave the punishment.
2026-10-29.myRecord: My record on the website: members can see their own moderation record.
2026-10-29.scheduledMessages: Scheduled and repeating messages from the dashboard.
2026-10-29.inbox: Dashboard: an Inbox for appeals, tickets, modmail and automod reviews, with replies from the web.
2026-10-29.websitePages: Website pages for the leaderboard, status, features, pricing, docs and FAQ.

2026-10-28.membersPage: Dashboard: a Members page with filters, roles, nicknames and timeouts, also for many members at once.
2026-10-28.temporaryRoles: Temporary roles that are taken away by themselves after a set time.
2026-10-28.bannedPage: Dashboard: a Banned page with everyone who is banned and why.
2026-10-28.channelTools: Dashboard: purge, lock and unlock channels, and post messages, polls and countdowns as the bot.
2026-10-28.appealsInSupportServer: Ban and kick appeals talk with the member in the support server.
2026-10-28.mutesInMassGuard: Mutes count toward the limit that stops one moderator from punishing many people in a short time.
